basic_info.description: Charming mid-century Ocean Beach cottage you will fall in love with! Rare rare rare. Amazing opportunity to live in a fantastic location near the beach and Great Highway in the desirable Outer Sunset Neighborhood of San Francisco. Surf, sea, sandy beach & city living all in one. Lovely south facing home detached on three and a half sides. Two large bedrooms looking out over a delightful outdoor space. Spacious and bright living area with high ceilings and large windows. Refreshed kitchen and new tile floor and shower in the bath. The upstairs den has ocean views, a large closet and has always been used as a third bedroom. 2094 48th Avenue is located near the highly rated Sunset Elementary School and is perfectly situated between the shops and transportation on Noriega and Taraval. Easy access to 280 for Peninsula commutes.
